name: Lightoor
longDescription:
lightoor is a permissionless memecoin launchpad on Robinhood Chain . Anyone can launch a coin with a 1,000,000,000 supply. Buys and sells run on a virtual constant-product curve until the coin graduates into a locked pool.

Lightoor is a perp-paired memecoin launchpad: each leveraged coin trades against a tokenized position backed by a Lighter perpetual market. Its backing can move with the underlying market even when the memecoin has no trades.
